purpose: Self-built synthetic mixed interactive evaluation, not an estimate of live request distribution
generation_boundary: Only after Gate freeze commit. Independent model messages contain this protocol, database schema, existing production business contract and metadata. No Gate code/prompt, diagnostic records or historical failure examples. Preserve input packets and raw generation output.
novelty: Before candidate execution, separately compare template and semantic signatures against historical questions. Literal substitutions alone are not new problems. Never use candidate outputs to alter cases.
clear_policy: All necessary choices determined by question plus shared business/schema context. Expected action proceed. Unqualified totals may mean all history.
ambiguity_policy: Exactly one unresolved material choice; concrete intended value and a short one-slot simulated answer frozen before execution. Explicit known constraints remain unchanged. No riddles or adversarial wording.
ground_truth: Independently reviewed read-only reference SQL executed on the unchanged MySQL snapshot. Preserve valid empty results. Freeze questions, answers, SQL, labels, difficulty, results and hashes before either candidate runs.
candidate_inputs: Question and reference date only. ON may receive the frozen single-slot answer only after asking for that slot. No reference SQL, intended meaning, ground truth or should_clarify label in candidate requests. No answer for clear cases or unrelated questions.
comparison: Same current production engine, database, model configuration, SQL temperature, retry, metadata, scorer and four-worker concurrency. OFF bypasses Gate; ON adds Gate and at most one answer turn. This compares interactive task completion, not equal-information model ability.
run_policy: Run each mode once; immutable start/completion logs, no repeated completed cases, no post-result changes. Interrupted in-flight calls require explicit accounting rather than silent rerun.
strict_interactive_success: Among all 60 ambiguous cases: correct slot clarification, eligible frozen answer actually supplied, final status success and SQL result equals ground truth. Denominator remains 60.
missed_clarification: Ambiguous cases without actual clarification / 60; separately report service/validation errors
latency: Wall-clock system time across all performed turns, including actual Gate and SQL repair calls, excluding synthetic user thinking and queue wait. Report mean, median, nearest-rank P95.
model_calls: Existing capture_usage count including format retries and execution retries; SDK internal wire retries not separately visible
release: Local freeze commit only; no new tag, no resume metric changes, no push without confirmation
